browser.sessionNote: Browser snapshots are local workspace checkpoints; restore loads an imported dirty session, not disk files.
browser.fileBackedNote: Snapshot save captures the current browser session. Use Save to files for real disk writes.
browser.serverBackedNote: Snapshots are stored on the local server and restore the real WSL/Linux config files.
